class UnequalIterablesError(Exception):
    """Exception raised to indicate that the input iterables of different lengths were passed to ``zip_equal``."""
    pass


def zip_equal(*iterables):
    """``zip`` the input *iterables* together, but raise ``UnequalIterablesError`` if they don't all have the same length.

        >>> list(zip_equal([1, 2, 3], ['a', 'b', 'c']))
        [(1, 'a'), (2, 'b'), (3, 'c')]

    Unlike ``itertools.zip_longest``, this function will stop when the shortest iterable is exhausted (like regular ``zip``), but will also check that all iterables have the same length and raise an error if they don't.

        >>> list(zip_equal([1, 2, 3], ['a', 'b']))
        Traceback (most recent call last):
            ...
        more_itertools.more.UnequalIterablesError: zip_equal() - unequal iterator lengths

    """
    sentinel = object()
    for item in zip_longest(*iterables, fillvalue=sentinel):
        if sentinel in item:
            raise UnequalIterablesError(
                "zip_equal() - unequal iterator lengths"
            )
        yield item
